name: browser/compare
title: Compare options
summary: Compare products or options: one row per option, one column per criterion, a source for each cell.
when: Use when the user is choosing between products, services or versions and wants them side by side.
steps: List the options as rows and the five criteria that matter as columns before searching for anything.
Call multi_search with one query per option plus specifications or price, and max_results 5 for each query.
Call fetch_pages with the official page of every option and one independent review, up to five urls.
Fill one cell per criterion from those passages and put the source number in the cell; leave a cell empty when nothing supports it.
Call calculate for every unit, currency or size conversion so one column uses one unit throughout.
Re-read the table and check each option has a row and each criterion a column, with every empty cell explained.
If a page cannot be read, keep its cells empty, name the source that failed and say the comparison is incomplete there.
Present the table, a three-line verdict and the numbered sources; the table carries the answer, not a wall of text.
next: The final answer must contain the comparison table with a source number in each cell, a short verdict and the numbered source list.
